==Description==
The '''Roblox Mystery Figure - Shotgunner''' was a character figure that can be obtained from the ''Roblox Mystery Figure Pack - Series 11''. It was released in January 2022. This toy is based on the second version of the Level 4 default [[Shotgunner]]. The toy is recommended for ages 6+ and is not suitable for children under 3 years old.

==Official Description==
*'''Online'''
*:Assemble the ultimate Roblox toy collection with these iconic characters from your favorite games! There are 24 new figures from Series 11 and each comes with a code for an exclusive virtual item that can be redeemed on Roblox. Collect them all!

==Prices & Stores==
The ''Roblox Mystery Figure Pack - Series 11'' has 24 figures that may be included. As you cannot guarantee what toy you get from the ''Roblox Mystery Figure Pack - Series 11'', there is no fixed price for the '''Roblox Mystery Figure - Shotgunner'''.

The rarity of this item is also unknown as each figure does not have the same rarity.

The costs and stores listed are for one purchase of the ''Roblox Mystery Figure Pack - Series 11'', unless stated otherwise. Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. Generally, it costs around $3.99-$12.47 in the US and £4.99 in the UK.

The stores in which you can buy the ''Roblox Mystery Figure Pack - Series 11'' depends on each country. The toy is subject to availability.
